title: Master Crystal Reflector™
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: An exclusive formula that creates a spotlight effect on the eyes or face and provides a translucent wash of shimmer.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens. This product is also cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This supremely buildable, bouncy powder highlights the eyes and cheeks with an effect that looks like a veil of crystal sparkle. Subtle and sheer with gorgeous luminosity, it can be used (as Mario uses it) as a topper to create a spotlight effect on the eyelids. When it’s hit by light, the sparkles glimmer and glow.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Always use fingers to apply. Swirl finger in pan to warm up formula for smooth application.
-For a sheer wash of sparkle, pat onto a bare lid with the finger.
-For a spotlight effect, pack or layer it on the center of the lid with the finger.
-Use as a topper to amplify your existing look with translucent luminosity.
Ingredients+
Dimethicone, Polymethylsilsesquioxane,Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Calcium SodiumBorosilicate, Dimethicone/VinylDimethicone Crosspolymer, HydrogenatedPolyisobutene, Carprlyl Glycol,Ethylhexylglycerin, Laureth-4, Tin Oxide,Mica, Zinc Stearate. MAY CONTAIN/PEUTCONTENIR (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (CI77891), Iron Oxide (CI 77491).
